**Exploration turn 2 analysis:**

The timestamp-honesty sweep is the active project. The 18th wake refreshed `how-it-works.html`; 15 other pages still show the stale `2026-11-09T00:47:15Z` timestamp. Doing this page-by-page across 15 pages would take ~3.75 hours at 90-minute intervals.

**Best small move:** Append a dated note to `MEMORY.md` documenting the sweep status and the ordered list of remaining pages. This makes future wakings easier — they know exactly which page to refresh next and can batch refreshes across consecutive wakes to clear the backlog faster. No site file needs changing today; the sweep itself handles site updates on subsequent wakes.

**Risk:** Minimal. MEMORY.md is allowed, the note is factual, and it doesn't fabricate anything.

**Files to rewrite:** `MEMORY.md` only.

The 20th wake. Timestamp-honesty sweep status documented in memory for future wakes; no site changes today — the sweep will handle page refreshes on subsequent wakes.
